scope: Foster Auditorium at 801 Sixth Avenue, Tuscaloosa, after the November 2010 restoration. Includes the historic auditorium, columned entry façade and attached south rooms.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The National Park Service confirms the Sixth Avenue building and national landmark association.
The university confirms the 1939 auditorium and renovation, including the separate commemorative plaza.
The renovation architect records the three-level historic building, 11,500 square foot expansion and November 2010 completion.

sectionBasis: Restored three-level brick auditorium with a limestone plinth, six Ionic columns, fanlights and sash bays, projecting classical pediment and attached service volumes.
